record.title: The Price of Token Boundaries: Compression Certificates and Prediction
record.summary: arXiv:2609.35869v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Pre-tokenisation restricts which text fragments can become prediction units, but its compression cost is obscured when tokenisers are compared only under the same boundaries. We measure this cost by bounding the minimum token count
record.reason: arXiv preprint reporting new research results on token-boundary compression cost, with a link to the original paper on arxiv.org.
